rules.statement: A party invoking the provisions of section 3 of the Prescription Ordinance must establish a starting point for their acquisition of prescriptive rights with consistent and credible evidence.
rules.supporting_quote: In order to defeat the ownership of an adverse claimant to immovable property, the burden of proof rests squarely and fairly on him to establish a starting point for his or her acquisition of prescriptive rights (Chelliah vs. Wijenathan 54 NLR 337, Solomon Dias vs. William Singho and others [2015] 1 SLR 277).
